name: First Desk
summary: A new-job card where an empty desk fills itself: monitor, lamp, mug, plant, badge and a Day 1 balloon
about: A bold, flat office scene for someone starting a new job. The desk rises into place and everything drops onto it with a squash and a bounce: the monitor boots up and says Welcome aboard with their name, the lamp lands and follows your pointer, the name plate, mug, plant and ID badge arrive, the chair rolls in and a Day 1 balloon floats up while the pinboard fills with a calendar for the first day. Type on your keyboard to write on their screen, press Start day one to tick off the first-day list, and copy a link with the name, job, company, date and your note.
how: Open the page: the desk builds itself in about three seconds and the screen starts cycling between welcome, a first-day list and your note.
Press Start day one: the lamp switches on, the to-do list ticks itself off, the badge swings and the welcome gift pops open.
Type on your keyboard to write on the monitor (Enter clears it); the keys on the desk light up as you type.
Click the chair, mug, plant, badge, gift, balloon or monitor; each one does something. Move the pointer and the lamp follows it.
In Make yours, type the name, job title, company and city, the first day and a note, or pick a ready one.
Copy the link (or Share on a phone) and send it; it opens this desk with your words and a countdown to day one.
